# Well&Content

Resources, tools, and support for neurodivergent creators.

> https://wellcontent.io

## About

Well&Content provides templates, guides, and blog posts designed around neurodivergent workflows — helping streamers, writers, artists, and content creators build sustainably without burnout.

Founded by Chloe, a content creator navigating ADHD and the realities of creating online since 2016.

## Templates

Free and low-cost productivity tools designed for neurodivergent creators:

- Content Energy Planner — plan your content based on your actual energy levels
- Creator 3-Day Reset Plan — a gentle reset for when you're feeling stuck or burnt out
- Notion Creator Dashboard — organize your content strategy in one place
- Notion Income & Expense Tracker — track your creator finances without overwhelm
- Obsidian Daily Planner — flexible daily structure that works on any energy level
- Obsidian Weekly Review — end-of-week reflection without pressure
- OBS Studio Preset — start streaming immediately with minimal setup
- OBS Studio 101 — comprehensive guide to setting up OBS without the overwhelm
- Comfy Chat Widget — calming stream overlay for neurodivergent streamers

> https://wellcontent.io/templates

## Blog

Articles on burnout, consistency, wellbeing, and sustainable content creation:

- Rethinking Productivity Advice For Neurodivergent Creators
- Use The PayPal Buffer System To Protect Your Creator Income
- Financial Sustainability Tips For Neurodivergent Streamers
- Protecting Your Privacy As A Streamer
- How to Add a Custom Chat Widget to Your Stream

> https://wellcontent.io/blog

This site is built for neurodivergent creators who want to build sustainably. All templates and guides focus on flexible systems that work with your energy, not against it.
